notes.title: Made Some Updates!
notes.notes: I have made graphics updates, some physics updates, sound updates and fixing updates over the past week. I hope you guys like these updates and it makes it better for your experience. If you have not updated and the its not showing to update, Right Click the game→Properties→Local Files→Verify Integrity of Game File. This update the game.

notes.title: Thank YOU! I plan on making updates!
notes.notes:
I released this game on the 19th! Was for monday but Steam would not unlock the game until last Thursday. I plan on making updates to improve and fix this game if needed. I already am working on some updates and will release them soon. 

If you have purchased my game, Thank YOU! I want to continue to make games and release them on steam.
